ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a convex pentagon on a coordinate grid, with five black points connected by line segments. It can be seen that the bottom side is horizontal, and the lower-left point and lower-right point are on the same horizontal line; the remaining vertices are located in order at a higher place on the left side, above, and at a higher place on the right side. The image confirms that the cyclic order of these points along the boundary is consistent with the order given in the problem text: (-1,-1), (-3,4), (1,7), (6,5), (3,-1). Reasoning: Use the exact coordinates given in the problem, and apply the shoelace formula according to the cyclic order confirmed by the image. Let the vertices in order be (-1,-1), (-3,4), (1,7), (6,5), (3,-1). The first sum of diagonal products is x_i y_{i+1}: (-1)(4)+(-3)(7)+(1)(5)+(6)(-1)+(3)(-1)=-4-21+5-6-3=-29. The second sum of diagonal products is y_i x_{i+1}: (-1)(-3)+(4)(1)+(7)(6)+(5)(3)+(-1)(-1)=3+4+42+15+1=65. Area = 1/2 |(-29)-65| = 1/2 · 94 = 47.
